final_message:
All 6 visible tests pass, plus extra checks against the documented edge cases. Bugs fixed:

1. **`parse_date` (parse.py)** — returned `(year, day, month)`. It swapped the month and day. Now returns `(year, month, day)`.
2. **`format_cents` (money.py)** — broke on negative values. Floor division on a negative number produced `-$-4.90` for `-310`. Now it formats `abs(cents)` and prepends the sign, so `-310` gives `-$3.10` and `-5` gives `-$0.05`.
3. **`top_items` (report.py)** — sorted totals ascending, so it returned the smallest items. It also ignored the tie-break rule. Now sorts by total descending, then item name ascending, as the docstring specifies.
